import json, urllib.request, ssl, time
ctx = ssl.create_default_context()

def fetch(url, timeout=15):
    req = urllib.request.Request(url)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout, context=ctx) as r:
            body = r.read()
            return r.status, body, dict(r.headers)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, e.read().decode()[:300], {}
    except Exception as ex:
        return 0, str(ex)[:200], {}

# Backend

h = json.loads(body) if st==200 else {}

v = json.loads(body2) if st2==200 else {}
st3, body3, _ = fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/commits/main')
gh = json.loads(body3) if st3==200 else {}

gh_sha = gh.get('sha','?')
api_sha = h.get('commit','?')
ver_sha = v.get('commit','?')

print('=== BACKEND (api.ivxholding.com) ===')
print(f'  /health:     HTTP {st}, status={h.get(\"status\")}, commit={api_sha[:12]}')
print(f'  /version:    HTTP {st2}, commit={ver_sha[:12]}')

print(f'  Boot:        {h.get(\"bootTime\")}')
print(f'  Routes:      {len(h.get(\"routes\",[]))}')
match = gh_sha == api_sha == ver_sha
print(f'  PARITY:      {\"PASS ✅\" if match else \"MISMATCH ❌\"} (GitHub={gh_sha[:12]} Render={api_sha[:12]})')
print()

# Landing page
st, body, hdrs = fetch('https://ivxholding.com')
print('=== LANDING PAGE (ivxholding.com) ===')

has_login = b'login' in body.lower() if isinstance(body, bytes) else 'login' in body.lower()
has_register = b'register' in body.lower() if isinstance(body, bytes) else 'register' in body.lower()
has_forgot = b'forgot' in body.lower() if isinstance(body, bytes) else 'forgot' in body.lower()
has_signup = b'signup' in body.lower() or b'sign-up' in body.lower() or b'sign up' in body.lower() if isinstance(body, bytes) else 'signup' in body.lower() or 'sign-up' in body.lower()

print(f'  Register form:  {\"YES ✅\" if has_register else \"NO ❌\"}')
print(f'  Forgot password:{\"YES ✅\" if has_forgot else \"NO ❌\"}')
print(f'  Sign up:        {\"YES ✅\" if has_signup else \"NO ❌\"}')
print()

print()
